name: Margherita di Savoia (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Margherita di Savoia (a daisy on blue) within branches, with a motto scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Margherita di Savoia, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Margherita di Savoia arms — daisy on blue, crowned, within branches, with motto scroll
